name: Waukesha's Equinox 2024
information: With the events being held at this competition, it is not recommended for first time competitors to attend. If you are looking for more popular events, such as 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, and Skewb, [DuPage Fall 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DuPageFall2024) is a 2-day competition the next weekend with several rounds of those events. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHN0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--50185814dd3aca6d46fbfd751cf63a2aa0a3739b/image.png)
